{{Top|leg}}
The drug '''cordrazine''' was used in the operating room to "jump-start" a being's vital systems, in the event that surgery brought a being close to [[Death/Legends|death]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wikipedia:Cordrazine|Cordrazine]] is a fictional drug that has appeared on [[Memoryalpha:Star Trek|''Star Trek'']] and [[Wikipedia:Mission: Impossible|''Mission: Impossible'']].
